sites.enforcement_snippet:
if sub.status in ("cancelled", "expired"):
    raise InvalidStateTransitionError(f"Cannot renew subscription in status {sub.status}")

domain_notes: renew_subscription rejects renewal when status is 'cancelled' or 'expired', guarded by a single membership check before it increments term_count. Both existing tests renew subscriptions in status 'active'; neither renews a cancelled or expired one, so the rejection path is never exercised.
rationale: Selected renew_subscription because its status membership check is the sole enforcement and no test renews a non-active subscription.
